newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's firm raises capital to $19 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's firm raises capital to $19 mln.

text.p: Morocco's credit company Eqdom said on Friday it increased by more than 50.3 precent its capital to 167 million dirhams ($19 million) through a bonus and rights issues.
The capital was 111.1 million dirhams before the increase, a stockbroker said.

The first increase was through an attribution of one new share for four old ones. The 281,500 new shares, of which 3,750 shares will be distributed to the staff, have a nominal value of 100 dirhams each.
Eqdom registered a net profit of 76.3 million dirhams for the first half of 1996 compared with 53.4 ($6.13 million the same period last year.
Eqdom, Morocco's first consumer credit company, was set up in 1974 by holding company Societe Nationale d'Investissement and major insurance companies.
